capabilities: Rank Solana tokens by five-minute on-chain volume.

capabilities: Query Birdeye's smart-money token feed for 1-day, 7-day or 30-day windows.

capabilities: Resolve a Solana token address to its name, symbol, decimals and metadata.

capabilities: Inspect the token-security response for authority, ownership and other provider-observed risk fields.

capabilities: Show the token's current indexed liquidity and valuation context.

capabilities: Analyze the indexed holder ranking and holder-stat snapshots under a disclosed denominator policy.

capabilities: Rank the token's indexed traders using the chosen Birdeye ordering and time frame.
